subject: Interlock: co-sell demo ops buffer & marketplace sync
messages:
From: Amit Shah <amit.shah@cloudforge.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@edge-systems.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Co-sell demo intro + availability

Hi Soojin and Karthik,

Thanks for the intro call last week — CloudForge is excited to co-present a short marketplace demo that highlights a joint SI workflow (CloudForge + Redwood) for inference migration to marketplace deployments. Priya from Edge Systems will be our SI lead on the technical portion.

High-level ask: can we lock a 60-minute joint demo (30m customer-facing demo, 30m ops/deep-dive) during the week of May 24-28? We need 
- a 15-minute pre-demo ops run-through the day prior, and
- one dry-run (30m) with SI + Redwood ops.

Constraints: our APAC SI will join remotely; for customer convenience we want US morning or early afternoon PT slots.

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue May 25: 10:30 - 12:00
- Wed May 26: 09:00 - 10:30
- Thu May 27: 13:00 - 14:30

Can you confirm who from Redwood should be on the ops dry-run? Also let us know if we should sync marketplace listing details with AWS Marketplace Ops ahead of the demo.

Thanks,

Amit Shah
Head of Partnerships | CloudForge
amit.shah@cloudforge.io | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: co-sell-outline.txt (stub)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.inference.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@cloudforge.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@edge-systems.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Co-sell demo intro + availability

Amit — great to hear, thanks. We can support the joint session and will be available for the windows below (PT):

- Tue May 25: 10:30 - 11:30 (tight)
- Wed May 26: 09:00 - 10:30 (preferred)
- Thu May 27: 13:00 - 14:00 (can compress to 45m)

Ops / dry-run: Vanessa (cc'd) will own the pre-demo ops run-through and the 30m dry-run with your SI. Vanessa, can you confirm a 30m slot on Tue May 24 (preferred) or Mon May 23?

Marketplace sync: Yes — please loop in Marketplace Ops (Amit, if you can send their contact or invite them directly that would be ideal). We'll share a short pre-demo checklist and a lightweight runbook (attached).

I've attached: CoSell_PreDemo_Checklist.pdf and ops-runbook-v1.odt.

Next steps: once Vanessa confirms the dry-run slot, I'll block the customer-facing slot (wed preferred) and we can circulate invites with speaker roles.

Sooj
Soojin Lee
Senior Partner GTM | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.inference.com | +1 650-555-0148

Attachments: CoSell_PreDemo_Checklist.pdf, ops-runbook-v1.odt

Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 09:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Co-sell demo intro + availability

Thanks Soojin — Wed May 26 09:00 PT works for us for the customer-facing session.

Marketplace Ops (cc) — can you confirm whether you need any additional metadata or a Marketplace listing draft before May 26 so the demo references match the listing? If yes, we'll prioritize a short sync.

Amit

Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Co-sell demo intro + availability

Adding ops details — thanks all. Quick notes and asks from Redwood ops: 

- Dry-run: Tue May 25 09:30 - 10:00 PT works for Vanessa + Karthik. Please confirm if SI can join 09:30 PT.
- Tech checks: we'll need: (1) shared Vulcan test account + temporary S3 bucket for demo assets, (2) a short runbook call-out for network egress/firewall rules.
- Presenter roles: Soojin (GTM intro), Amit/Priya (SI customer intro + customer ask), Karthik (model routing + failover), Vanessa (ops).

I've attached a trimmed ops-runbook excerpt in the body below for quick scanning. If Marketplace Ops requires a sandbox listing preview, we can push a draft by EOD Tue May 18.

----- Begin runbook excerpt -----
- Test account: redwood-demo-temp@redwood.inference.com (creds via 1Password shared vault)
- S3 path: s3://redwood-demo/cloudforge/assets/
- Recommended instance: c6gn.8xlarge for the inference segment (demo scale)
- Dry-run checklist: ingress rules, KV cache warm, sample prompt set (attached)
----- End runbook excerpt -----

Vanessa Ortiz
Platform Reliability Lead | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference.com | +1 415-555-0124
From: Priya Rao <priya.rao@edge-systems.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.inference.com>, Amit Shah <amit.shah@cloudforge.io>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Co-sell demo intro + availability

Thanks — confirmed on our side: SI can join Tue May 25 09:30 PT for dry-run and Wed May 26 09:00 PT for customer demo. We'll also accept the EOD Tue May 18 milestone for a marketplace listing draft.

Two asks from Edge Systems: 
1) Can Redwood share the sample prompt set and token budget for the customer-facing demo (we want to ensure parity with the production-like workload)?
2) Please include Marketplace Ops on the dry-run invite if they want to observe.

We'll follow up with the SI's dial-in details and the APAC overlap plan for the customer portion.

Priya Rao
